fields.note: Published as <h4> section headings above the accordion cards; there is no filter control.

notes: The ledger URL https://www.nationwithnamo.com/careers is a 404; the company-owned careers host https://careers.nationwithnamo.com/ serves one static page with an Open Positions accordion grouped under four department headings. The page has no search input, no location/employment-type/workplace filter, no pagination and no listing API; department is only a local grouping/filter dimension. The adapter collects the full page.
